text.tspan: PF-AEBS-010-001: Build and boot the pinned sdv_ivi_cf target.
PF-AEBS-010-002: Observe package manager, system server, display composition, vehicle service, and SDV Gateway.
PF-AEBS-010-003: Prove Data Tunnel discovery/subscription with the documented Java sample.
PF-AEBS-010-004: Native Gateway publisher and Java subscriber exchange a bounded payload.
PF-AEBS-010-005: IVI guest reaches the ROS-side frame server over the selected connection.
PF-AEBS-010-006: Documented Gateway APIs only; any fork/patch needs maintainer involvement and approval first.
If any mandatory gate cannot be executed at the pinned revision, the
chain stops at Phase 8 with a blocked realization decision and a
separate enabling slice. No host webpage, screenshot mock, direct host
rendering, or unreviewed upstream fork is an acceptable fallback.
